title: Qwen3-TTS0.6B4bit: volume-bound serial speaker attempt
scope: Actual production playback backing with native48k mono microphone observation under paced native Parakeet-v3 decoder load. Threshold-qualified arrival, not human perception or full-turn latency.
summary: 27/30 warm pickups qualified. No warm acoustic median accepted.

environment.hardware: Apple M3 MacBook Air,16GB RAM,256GB storage
environment.workload: Paced cached native Parakeet-v3 authored prefixes,400ms then1s updates. Model preparation precedes reference-decoder warmup. Actual RPC responses overlap every completed timed request; maximum response gap within a request1.18s. Not selected-ASR/AEC/EOU acceptance.
environment.cold_warm: One separate first-after-prepare request; 30 completed varied warm requests, cycling five English phrases. No voice-quality inference.
environment.audio_route: Built-in speakers/microphone; native48000Hz mono float32; source gain0.75. Hardware output38%,input51%,unmuted checked at each trial start/end with device IDs. Original output12.5% restored after cohort. No continuous route-transition proof.

provenance.command: See calibrated-command.json: --speaker-output --trials 30 --reference-asr-probe; one model prepares, reference decoder warms, timed requests run, both children join and owned assets are deleted before next.
provenance.grader: Native host timestamps; two consecutive10ms windows above max(.001RMS,4x room baseline), >=.75 rendered/microphone envelope correlation, strict timestamps/callbacktokens/route/drop gates. No survivor-only acoustic medians. Baseline is the immediate preceding500ms. Hardware gain/mute joins device IDs in route signature. Qwen uses pinned25-token decoder batches; precision and joined whole-clause API unchanged.

limitations: Five-model comparison remains incomplete: Qwen27/30, Apple30/30; Phonon hit live disk guard; Pocket/Kokoro refused before download. No fastest-five default promotion.
Microphone pickup is threshold-dependent and includes acoustic/input timing; it is not human perceptual onset.
Render and queried presentation estimates are separate component boundaries and do not substitute for physical output.
Global utterance-envelope correlation does not independently prove every earliest transient belongs to the utterance; click/cough, route/format and double-talk controls remain open.
Five English phrases, one route; no general language/voice-quality or production full-duplex/EOU acceptance.
Timestamp regressions in the earlier converted16k collector are retained as superseded evidence; this report uses the native-format observer.

Smaller decoder batches completed synthesis but boundary continuity/intelligibility and the total disk-pressure allocating producer remain unproved; lower peak is a scoped observation, not a complete disk repair.
